prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Use a clear, front-facing photo with good lighting for best desktop rendering.", "Supported formats: PNG, JPG. Ensure your pet face is centered."]
1: ["Choose Your Desktop Companion", "Select a pet persona that fits your working style and desktop vibe.", "Playful Pup, Calm Kitty, Focus Owl"]
2: ["Sign In to Restore Your Pets", "Log into your account to safely access your saved pets, custom items, and desktop preferences.", "Using the same email will automatically sync your existing pet collection."]
3: ["Check Your Desktop Screen", "Ensure window permissions allow your pet to walk freely on top of open applications.", "Confirm Pet Visible"]
4: ["Did you know? Double-clicking your pet triggers a happy animation on your screen!"]
5: ["How Would You Like to Start?", "Pick an instant companion or create your own custom pet from scratch.", "Instant Ready Pet vs Custom Photo Creation"]
6: ["Press Alt+P anytime to open pet controls or right-click your pet to manage settings.", "Shortcut Tip: Right-click pet for Quick Menu"]
7: []
8: ["Taking time? You can also pick from our preset sample images to jump right in!"]
9: ["Meet Your Desktop Sidekick in 60 Seconds", "Bring your screen to life with an interactive digital pet companion that lives on your desktop.", "Start Setup"]
